from statsbombpy import sb
import pandas as pd
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import warnings
from statsbombpy.api_client import NoAuthWarning

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=NoAuthWarning)

all_matches = []

competitions = sb.competitions()

for _, c in competitions.iterrows():
    matches = sb.matches(c["competition_id"], c["season_id"])
    all_matches.append(matches)

matches = pd.concat(all_matches, ignore_index=True)

#display(matches)

schema = StructType([
    StructField("match_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("match_date", StringType(), True),
    StructField("kick_off", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_score", ByteType(), True),
    StructField("away_score", ByteType(), True),
    StructField("match_status", StringType(), True),
    StructField("match_status_360", StringType(), True),
    StructField("last_updated", StringType(), True),
    StructField("last_updated_360", StringType(), True),
    StructField("match_week", ShortType(), True),
    StructField("competition_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("competition_country_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("competition_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("competition", StringType(), True),
    StructField("season_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("season", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_team_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_team", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_team_gender", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_team_group", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_team_country_id", LongType(), True),
    StructField("home_team_country_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_team_id", LongType(), True),
    StructField("away_team", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_team_gender", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_team_group", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_team_country_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_team_country_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("competition_stage_id", LongType(), True),
    StructField("competition_stage", StringType(), True),
    StructField("stadium_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("stadium", StringType(), True),
    StructField("stadium_country_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("stadium_country_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("referee_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("referee", StringType(), True),
    StructField("referee_country_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("referee_country_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_managers", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_managers", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_manager_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_manager_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_manager_nickname", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_manager_dob", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_manager_country_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_manager_country_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_manager_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_manager_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_manager_nickname", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_manager_dob", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_manager_country_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("away_manager_country_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("data_version", StringType(), True),
    StructField("shot_fidelity_version", StringType(), True),
    StructField("xy_fidelity_version", StringType(), True)    
])

df_matches = spark.createDataFrame(matches, schema=schema)

all_lineups = []

for match_id in matches['match_id']:
    lineups = sb.lineups(match_id)

    for team, lineup_df in lineups.items():
        lineup_df = lineup_df.copy()
        lineup_df['match_id'] = match_id
        lineup_df['team'] = team
        all_lineups.append(lineup_df)

lineups = pd.concat(all_lineups, ignore_index=True)

match_frames = sb.frames(match_id=3772072, fmt='dataframe')
comp_frames = sb.competition_frames(
    country="Germany",
    division= "1. Bundesliga",
    season="2019/2020"
)
